Ciklum is looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer to join our team in Brazil.

With a global team of over 4,000 highly skilled developers, consultants, analysts and product owners, we engineer technology that redefines industries and shapes the way people live.

As a Senior Full Stack Engineer, you'll become a part of a cross-functional development team engineering experience of tomorrow. In this role, you will become part of a small, senior product engineering team for an established US mental health platform where clients book licensed psychologists and psychotherapists, complete with US insurance integrations and subscription billing. - Frontend Architecture: Own and evolve the frontend architecture, including component libraries, design systems, state management, and clear module boundaries for the engineering team

- Backend & API Development: Build and maintain scalable backend services and APIs (REST, GraphQL, or gRPC), covering authentication, RBAC, billing workflows, and audit logging

- Code Quality & Testing: Write clean, secure, and maintainable code; establish and drive a risk-based testing strategy with strong end-to-end test coverage

- Internal Tooling & AI Adoption: Develop internal productivity tooling (CLIs, agent-based workflows) and proactively utilize AI coding tools as force multipliers

- Engineering Excellence & Mentorship: Conduct rigorous code reviews, champion engineering best practices, and mentor teammates in adopting modern standards

- Cross-functional Collaboration: Partner closely with product management, UX/UI design, and executive leadership to shape the roadmap and guide core UX decisions

Requirements:

- Experience: 6+ years of commercial software engineering experience, with a proven track record of building and scaling SaaS products as a Full Stack Engineer

- Communication: Upper-Intermediate to Advanced (Fluent) English proficiency, both written and spoken

- Software Design & Architecture:

- Demonstrated experience designing solutions for complex features and maintaining comprehensive technical documentation

- Deep understanding of API architectural styles (monolith, microservices, serverless), design patterns, and engineering standards

- Hands-on experience defining frontend architecture (design systems, shared component libraries) utilized by multiple developers

- Proven ownership of critical product domains from discovery to launch (e.g., onboarding, billing, access control)

- Software Development:

- Strong proficiency in TypeScript, modern JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, and advanced React patterns

- Solid background in Node.js or Python building high-performance backend services; willingness and ability to work primarily in a Python / FastAPI codebase

- Strong relational database skills in PostgreSQL (data modeling, schema design, complex queries, and aggregations)

- Practical commercial experience with distributed systems and event-driven patterns using message brokers (Kafka, RabbitMQ, SQS, etc.)

- Quality Assurance:

- Hands-on experience with modern testing frameworks across the stack (e.g., Jest, Vitest, Playwright, Cypress, pytest)

- Ability to define, track, and maintain code quality metrics; familiarity with observability, monitoring, and logging tools

- DevOps & Cloud Deployment:

- Practical knowledge of containerization (Docker) and CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI, GitHub Actions)

- Experience deploying, configuring, and operating backend services on a public cloud (GCP or AWS)

- Ways of Working:

- High degree of autonomy and seniority: ability to lead a problem space independently, balance technical trade-offs, and communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders

- Availability for a 3–4 hour daily working overlap with US Pacific Time (PT) for key ceremonies, planning, and stand-ups

Desirable:

- Prior experience as a Founding Engineer, Tech Lead, or core team member at an early-stage or growth-stage product company

- Domain knowledge in HealthTech / Digital Health (HIPAA compliance, health insurance workflows) or FinTech / Payments

- Production experience with Stripe billing, subscription life-cycles, and payment processing

- Familiarity with Micro-frontends, Next.js, React Native, or Expo

- Hands-on experience with Go, Elixir / Phoenix, or gRPC

- Exposure to Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) and container orchestration (Kubernetes / GKE)

- Experience developing MCP servers, CLI developer tools, or LLM-assisted internal automations

- Active involvement in hiring, conducting technical interviews, and mentoring junior/middle engineers

- Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field

MISUMI Americas, a division of MISUMI Group, is a leading provider of standard, configurable, and custom manufacturing solutions. With operations in the San Francisco Bay Area and Chicago, the company serves as a vital partner for the most innovative companies in the Americas.

About Compass
Compass is a new venture incubated within MISUMI Americas. We’re building it with the deep manufacturing expertise of Fictiv , MISUMI’s digital manufacturing platform.
Every physical product starts as a CAD model, and most of what it will cost is decided right there. Yet cost and manufacturability are still checked after the drawings are released, by hand and in spreadsheets, when every change is slow and expensive. The result is redesigns, missed schedules, and money left on the factory floor. Compass fixes that at the source. An engineer uploads an assembly, and Compass reads every part the way an expert manufacturing engineer would. It checks each feature against the processes that could make it, prices the part at the volume that matters, reads tolerances and GD&T straight off the drawing, and ranks exactly what to change. It does this across the entire bill of materials, reruns on every revision, and learns from every correction engineers make.
The problems underneath are genuinely hard: making sense of real-world geometry, modeling cost across machining, casting, molding, sheet metal, and additive, interpreting engineering drawings, and building AI that gets measurably better from expert feedback. The stakes are real, too. Our customers are enterprise engineering teams, including aerospace and defense programs, where the platform has to be as secure and trustworthy as it is smart. Compass is a small team that moves fast and gives engineers real ownership. You won’t inherit a finished system. You’ll help define the architecture, the security foundation, and the product that the most demanding customers in manufacturing will rely on.
About the Role
We’re looking for a cross-functional software engineer who thrives at the intersection of application development and cloud infrastructure. We’re scaling the product, fast-tracking SOC 2 Type I and Type II, and building an ITAR-ready environment for aerospace and defense customers. You’ll be one of the engineers who makes all three happen.
We don’t need a pure DevOps specialist managing servers all day. We need an engineer who treats infrastructure as code, automates our cloud environment to satisfy security audits, and writes clean application code to ship features customers use.
You’ll own our AWS infrastructure and CI/CD pipelines. In your first months, much of your time will go to building our compliance foundation. Over time, the role settles into roughly 30% platform automation and 70% full-stack feature development.

- Build our ITAR environment. Help design and run an isolated AWS GovCloud environment for customers with export-controlled data, with access restricted to US persons.

- Own the platform. Manage, monitor, and scale our AWS environment using infrastructure as code (Terraform, AWS CDK, or Pulumi), with no manual configuration drift.

- Build across the stack. Design, write, and deploy maintainable backend APIs and frontend features for our core product.

- Automate everything. Maintain CI/CD pipelines (such as GitHub Actions) with automated testing, dependency scanning, and secure deployments built in.

- Keep the architecture lean. Favor managed AWS services so the infrastructure needs minimal babysitting and you can focus on product.

- AWS expertise. Deep hands-on experience with managed and serverless AWS services, such as Elastic Beanstalk, Lambda, RDS, SQS, Cognito, IAM, and CloudTrail.

- Infrastructure as code. Proven experience managing cloud environments entirely through code (such as Terraform or AWS CDK) rather than the console.
